papers.title: Patient-initiated follow-up in surgical specialties: meta-analysis and meta-regression
papers.authors: Pitesa R, Moody S, Hill A
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Rising outpatient demand has accelerated adoption of patient-initiated follow-up in surgical practice. This review evaluated whether patient-initiated follow-up safely reduces clinic burden while maintaining patient outcomes across specialties.
METHODS: MEDLINE, Embase, and CENTRAL were searched (2014-2025) for studies of patient-initiated follow-up, defined as a model enabling clinically stable patients to self-initiate follow-up when new or concerning symptoms arise, rather than attending prearranged appointments. Primary outcomes included outpatient appointment volume and patient-reported quality of life. Where studies reported single-arm utilization data, a random-effects meta-analysis of proportions was undertaken. Exploratory meta-regression examined pathway-level factors associated with utilization. Randomized clinical trials (RCTs) were assessed using the revised Cochrane risk-of-bias 2 tool, observational cohort studies using the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale, and qualitative studies using the Critical Appraisal Skills Programme checklist.
RESULTS: Of 1776 manuscripts identified, 34 studies across 6 surgical specialties (breast, colorectal, otorhinolaryngology, orthopaedics, plastics, and urology) were included: 4 RCTs, 17 observational cohort studies, 11 qualitative studies, and 2 mixed-methods studies. Observational studies consistently reported reductions in routine outpatient attendance-including a reduction from 45·0% to 6·0% in first specialist appointments in patient-initiated follow-up in colorectal surgery (P < 0·001) and 52·5% of patients with high-risk cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma not recontacting the clinic-without evidence of increased adverse outcomes. RCTs demonstrated non-inferior patient-reported quality-of-life outcomes with patient-initiated versus standard follow-up, alongside reductions in physician contact, including a 50% reduction in planned consultations in breast cancer (1·9 versus 3·8 per patient; P < 0·001) and a reduction in specialist contacts from 42·0% to 23·0% in rectal cancer. In a meta-analysis (1806 participants), the pooled patient-initiated follow-up utilization proportion was 0·19 (95% confidence interval 0·09 to 0·36; I2 = 95%), indicating substantial context-dependent variation. In oncological settings-particularly breast, colorectal, melanoma, and head and neck cancer-structured surveillance and rapid-access systems were identified as critical safety adjuncts to implementation.
CONCLUSION: Patient-initiated follow-up can reduce outpatient burden in selected surgical populations without compromising patient-reported outcomes; however, its effects are dependent on the clinical context and pathway design. Risk-stratified and hybrid models may be the most appropriate, particularly in oncology. Further high-quality trials and robust economic evaluations are required to define optimal implementation strategies.
papers.title_zh: 外科各次專科之病人自主啟動追蹤：統合分析與統合迴歸
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：門診需求上升加速了外科臨床實務中病人自主啟動追蹤模式的採用。本篇文獻回顧評估病人自主啟動追蹤是否能在維持病人結果的同時，安全地減輕門診負擔，並涵蓋多個次專科。

方法：檢索MEDLINE、Embase及CENTRAL（2014-2025年）中關於病人自主啟動追蹤的研究，定義為讓臨床穩定病人在出現新發或令人擔憂的症狀時自行啟動追蹤，而非依既定排程回診。主要outcome包括門診就診量與病人自述生活品質。對於報告單組使用率資料的研究，採用隨機效應比例統合分析。探索性統合迴歸檢視與使用率相關的路徑層級因子。RCT使用Cochrane風險偏誤2.0工具評估，觀察性世代研究使用Newcastle-Ottawa量表，質性研究使用CASP檢核表評估。

結果：從1776篇文獻中，共納入34篇研究，涵蓋6個外科次專科（乳房、大腸直腸、耳鼻喉、骨科、整形、泌尿），包括4篇RCT、17篇觀察性世代研究、11篇質性研究、2篇混合方法研究。觀察性研究一致顯示常規門診就診量減少──包括大腸直腸外科中病人自主啟動追蹤使初次專科門診比例從45.0%降至6.0%（P<0.001），以及52.5%高風險皮膚鱗狀細胞癌病人未再與門診聯繫──且未發現不良結果增加。RCT顯示病人自主啟動追蹤與標準追蹤相比，病人自述生活品質為非劣性，同時減少醫師接觸，包括乳癌病人計劃性門診減少50%（每人1.9次 vs 3.8次，P<0.001），以及直腸癌專科接觸率從42.0%降至23.0%。在統合分析中（1806名參與者），彙整之病人自主啟動追蹤使用比例為0.19（95%信賴區間0.09至0.36；I2=95%），顯示因情境而有顯著變異。在腫瘤學情境中──特別是乳癌、大腸直腸癌、黑色素瘤及頭頸癌──結構化監測與快速回診系統被認定為執行時的重要安全輔助措施。

結論：病人自主啟動追蹤可在特定外科族群中減輕門診負擔，且不損及病人自述結果；然而其效果取決於臨床情境與路徑設計。風險分層與混合模式可能最為適當，尤其在腫瘤學領域。仍需更高品質的試驗與嚴謹的經濟評估以確立最佳執行策略。
papers.score_reason: 統合分析方法嚴謹但納入研究異質性極高(I2=95%)、僅4篇RCT，對大腸直腸實務有方向性參考價值但難直接複製到台灣單一機構。
papers.relevance_why: 直接涵蓋大腸直腸癌與直腸癌病人自主啟動追蹤的門診負擔與QoL資料，是門診壅塞下的實務議題。
papers.one_liner: 在34篇研究(含大腸直腸/直腸癌)中，比較病人自主啟動追蹤與傳統回診，發現直腸癌專科接觸率42%降至23%且QoL無差異。
papers.action: 可評估於低風險、病情穩定之大腸直腸癌病人試行PIFU並搭配快速回診機制，暫不建議廣泛取代常規腫瘤追蹤。

pico.P: 34篇研究，6種外科次專科(乳房、大腸直腸、耳鼻喉、骨科、整形、泌尿)，統合分析部分納入1806名參與者
pico.C: 傳統定期排程回診追蹤
pico.O: 主要：門診就診量、病人自述生活品質；次要：PIFU使用率、專科聯繫頻率、不良事件

key_numbers: 大腸直腸初次專科門診比例 45.0% vs 6.0%，p<0.001（單一觀察性研究）
直腸癌專科接觸率 42.0% vs 23.0%（RCT資料，PIFU vs 標準追蹤）
PIFU整體彙整使用率僅19%（95% CI 9-36%），研究間異質性極高I2=95%
cautions: 納入34篇研究涵蓋6種次專科、異質性極高(I2=95%)，大腸直腸癌相關數字多來自單一研究非彙整結果
僅4篇RCT，多數為觀察性前後對照設計，易受選擇偏誤與時間趨勢干擾，因果推論受限
主要outcome為門診使用量與QoL替代指標，未明確報告腫瘤復發偵測延誤或長期存活等硬指標
unassessable: 大腸直腸個別研究之病人數與追蹤期間
PIFU是否延誤腫瘤復發偵測

papers.title: Methodological challenges in surgical randomized trials: systematic review of rectal cancer studies
papers.authors: Kitaguchi D, Giménez M, Forgione A, Oda T, Marescaux J
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Surgical randomized clinical trials (RCTs) have structural features that differ fundamentally from those of non-surgical trials, which may complicate appraisal using standard assessment frameworks. This methodological systematic review used rectal cancer surgery RCTs as a high-complexity exemplar to identify surgically specific methodological challenges and to examine their interaction with established tools for assessing risk of bias and certainty of evidence.
METHODS: A systematic literature search was conducted in PubMed, Embase, and the Cochrane Library on 1 November 2025. Eligible studies were RCTs evaluating surgery-related interventions for rectal cancer in adult patients, published in English from 2020 onward, with sufficient methodological detail. Included trials were categorized into predefined, mutually exclusive surgical RCT types. Methodological features were descriptively summarized and conceptually mapped to the domains of the revised Cochrane Risk of Bias (RoB 2) tool and the GRADE framework using both quantitative tabulation and narrative synthesis.
RESULTS: Of 1529 records identified, 45 publications reporting on 35 RCTs were included. Trials were classified into five surgical RCT categories. Surgically specific methodological challenges were most frequently observed in RoB 2 domains D2 (bias due to deviations from intended interventions) and D4 (bias in measurement of the outcome), as well as in the GRADE domain of indirectness.
CONCLUSION: This review suggests that several challenges encountered when applying RoB 2 and GRADE to surgical RCTs arise from structural characteristics of surgical trial design rather than obvious methodological shortcomings. Contextualizing standard appraisal frameworks within the realities of surgical research may allow for a more nuanced interpretation of existing evidence, inform future trial design, and support more appropriate evidence synthesis.

papers.title_zh: 外科隨機對照試驗的方法學挑戰：直腸癌研究之系統性回顧
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：外科隨機對照試驗（RCT）具有與非外科試驗根本不同的結構性特徵，可能使標準評估框架的應用複雜化。本方法學系統性回顧以直腸癌手術RCT作為高複雜度範例，旨在辨識外科特有的方法學挑戰，並檢視其與既有偏誤風險及證據確定性評估工具之間的互動關係。方法：於2025年11月1日在PubMed、Embase及Cochrane圖書館進行系統性文獻檢索。納入標準為：評估成人直腸癌患者手術相關介入之RCT，2020年後以英文發表，且具備足夠方法學細節者。納入試驗依據預先定義、互斥的外科RCT類型加以分類。方法學特徵以描述性方式總結，並概念性對應至修訂版Cochrane偏誤風險（RoB 2）工具與GRADE框架之各領域，同時採用量化列表與敘事性綜合分析。結果：共識別1529篇文獻紀錄，最終納入45篇出版物，涵蓋35個RCT。試驗被分類為五種外科RCT類型。外科特有的方法學挑戰最常出現於RoB 2工具的D2領域（因偏離預定介入所致之偏誤）及D4領域（結果測量之偏誤），以及GRADE框架中的間接性（indirectness）領域。結論：本回顧顯示，將RoB 2與GRADE應用於外科RCT時所遭遇的多項挑戰，源自外科試驗設計的結構性特徵，而非明顯的方法學缺陷。將標準評估框架置於外科研究的現實脈絡下理解，可望使既有證據獲得更細緻的詮釋、有助於未來試驗設計，並支持更適切的證據綜合分析。
papers.score_reason: 方法學層面嚴謹且具原創性，但屬於「評估評估工具」的元研究，不提供任何臨床結果數據，對明日臨床決策無直接影響。
papers.relevance_why: 此文探討如何正確解讀/批判外科RCT證據等級，對做研究、寫論文、審查證據的外科醫師有幫助，但非直接臨床介入研究。
papers.one_liner: 分析2020年後35個直腸癌手術RCT（45篇文獻），評估RoB2/GRADE框架應用挑戰，主要集中於D2、D4與間接性領域。
papers.action: 目前不需改變臨床做法；此文可作為未來設計/審閱手術RCT，或批判性閱讀直腸癌手術證據時的方法學參考。

pico.P: 2020年後發表、評估直腸癌手術相關介入之RCT，共45篇文獻、35個試驗
pico.I: 以RoB 2與GRADE框架系統性評估這些外科RCT的方法學特徵
pico.C: 無對照組（本身為方法學系統性回顧，非臨床介入比較）
pico.O: 主要：辨識外科RCT在RoB2各領域及GRADE間接性領域的特有挑戰；次要：提出外科RCT分類與證據綜合建議

key_numbers: 自1529篇篩選文獻中，最終納入45篇論文、35個RCT
主要方法學挑戰集中於RoB2的D2（偏離預定介入）與D4（結果測量偏誤）領域
GRADE框架中最常見問題為間接性（indirectness），非隨機化或失訪偏誤
cautions: 本文為方法學回顧，非臨床結果研究，摘要未提供任何具體介入的療效或安全性數據
未說明納入35個RCT分別探討何種手術主題（如TME方式、吻合技術等），無法對應到具體臨床情境
結論多為敘事性整合，缺乏量化指標（如各領域偏誤發生率百分比）佐證其結論強度

文獻選擇與資料萃取的獨立性/一致性檢驗方式
papers.context: 無相關前作。之前列出的論文為數位健康介入對CRC患者生活品質之統合分析，與本篇探討外科RCT方法學評估框架的主題完全不同，無實質關聯。

papers.title: Defining absolute postoperative desmoid risk in familial adenomatous polyposis according to APC genotype and family history: retrospective cohort study
papers.authors: Zare B, Bahar M, Clark S, Latchford A
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Desmoid disease is a major cause of morbidity and mortality in familial adenomatous polyposis (FAP), particularly after prophylactic colorectal surgery. Although APC genotype and family history are recognized risk factors, previous sizeable studies report relative rather than absolute risks. This study aimed to quantify absolute postoperative desmoid risk in FAP patients undergoing risk-reducing colectomy, stratified by APC genotype, and to assess the modifying effect of family history.
METHODS: This retrospective observational study used records from a prospectively maintained registry. Patients with an APC pathogenic variant (PV) 3' of codon 1399 were classified as high risk, and those with an APC PV 5' of (or at) codon 1399 were classified as low risk. Patients who had not undergone prophylactic colectomy, with < 5 years of postoperative follow-up, or those with a desmoid diagnosed before or at the time of surgery were excluded. Clinical records were reviewed for details of surgery, desmoid diagnosis, and family history. A positive family history was defined as a first-degree relative with genetically confirmed FAP and a diagnosis of desmoid disease (clinical and/or radiological).
RESULTS: Among 48 high-risk patients, 30 (63%) developed desmoid, with no significant difference between colectomy and proctocolectomy (54% versus 70%, respectively; χ2 = 1.42; P = 0.233). Family history was present in 35 of the 48 patients (73%) and increased desmoid risk relative to no family history (80% versus 15%, respectively; P < 0.01). Among the 1213 low-risk patients, 154 (12.7%) developed desmoids, with no significant effect of surgical procedure (13.9% versus 12.1% for proctocolectomy and total/partial colectomy, respectively; χ² = 0.77; P = 0.380). Family history increased desmoid risk relative to no family history (30% versus 10%, respectively; P < 0.01).
CONCLUSION: A family history of desmoid disease appears to be an important determinant of postoperative desmoid risk in FAP. Although APC PV 3' of codon 1399 does confer a high overall risk, this is largely confined to individuals with first-degree relatives with desmoid. In the absence of a family history, postoperative desmoid risk appeared relatively low regardless of genotype. This supports a more individualized approach to perioperative counselling and surgical decision-making in patients with FAP. In addition, these data highlight that patients with both a 3' APC PV and a positive family history are a particularly high-risk subgroup who may represent an appropriate target population for future chemoprevention trials.

papers.title_zh: 依據APC基因型與家族史定義家族性大腸腺瘤性息肉症術後Desmoid絕對風險：回溯性世代研究
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：Desmoid疾病是家族性大腸腺瘤性息肉症（FAP）病人罹病與死亡的主要原因，尤其是在接受預防性大腸直腸手術之後。雖然APC基因型與家族史已被認定為危險因子，先前規模較大的研究報告的是相對風險而非絕對風險。本研究目的為量化接受風險降低性結腸切除術之FAP病人術後Desmoid的絕對風險，依APC基因型分層，並評估家族史的修飾效應。方法：本回溯性觀察研究使用前瞻性維護登錄資料庫的紀錄。APC致病性變異（PV）位於第1399號codon 3'端者分類為高風險，位於（或恰好在）第1399號codon 5'端者分類為低風險。排除未接受預防性結腸切除術、術後追蹤<5年，或於手術前或手術當時已診斷Desmoid者。回顧臨床紀錄以取得手術細節、Desmoid診斷與家族史資訊。陽性家族史定義為一位一級親屬經基因確診FAP且被診斷Desmoid疾病（臨床及/或影像學）。結果：在48位高風險病人中，30位（63%）發生Desmoid，結腸切除術與全結腸直腸切除術之間無顯著差異（分別為54%對70%；χ2=1.42；P=0.233）。48位病人中35位（73%）有家族史，家族史相較於無家族史增加Desmoid風險（分別為80%對15%；P<0.01）。在1213位低風險病人中，154位（12.7%）發生Desmoid，手術方式無顯著影響（全結腸直腸切除術與全/部分結腸切除術分別為13.9%對12.1%；χ²=0.77；P=0.380）。家族史相較於無家族史增加Desmoid風險（分別為30%對10%；P<0.01）。結論：FAP病人的Desmoid疾病家族史似為術後Desmoid風險的重要決定因子。雖然位於第1399號codon 3'端的APC PV確實帶來較高的整體風險，但此風險主要侷限於有一級親屬罹患Desmoid的個體。在無家族史的情況下，無論基因型如何，術後Desmoid風險似乎相對較低。這支持在FAP病人中採取更個別化的圍術期諮詢與手術決策方式。此外，這些數據強調同時具有3' APC PV與陽性家族史的病人是特別高風險的次群體，可能是未來化學預防試驗適合的目標族群。
papers.score_reason: 大規模登錄資料提供罕見但臨床重要的絕對風險數字，實用性高，但高風險組樣本小（n=48）且手術方式比較非隨機、可能有適應症混淆。
papers.relevance_why: 直接影響FAP病人預防性手術前的Desmoid風險諮詢與手術決策，是大腸直腸外科日常照護FAP病人的核心議題。
papers.one_liner: 在48名高風險與1213名低風險FAP病人中，家族史使Desmoid風險由15%升至80%（高風險組）、10%升至30%（低風險組）。

papers.title: Fruquintinib: Mechanism of Action, Clinical, and Translational Science
papers.authors: Zhou X, Dasari A, Li J, Chien C, Dong Q, Chen L
papers.abstract: Fruquintinib is a highly selective, oral inhibitor of all three vascular endothelial growth factor receptors (-1, -2, and -3) that was approved, including in China, the United States, and the European Union, for the treatment of previously treated metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC). The efficacy of fruquintinib for mCRC has been consistently demonstrated in randomized, double-blind, Phase 3 clinical studies, including FRESCO (NCT02314819), which enrolled patients in China, and FRESCO-2 (NCT04322539), which enrolled patients across 14 countries in North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia. In both studies, patients were randomized 2:1 to receive oral fruquintinib 5 mg or a matching placebo once daily, 3 weeks on, 1 week off, in 28-day cycles, plus best supportive care, until progression or unacceptable toxicity. Both FRESCO and FRESCO-2 met their primary endpoints, demonstrating significant improvements in overall survival (OS) with fruquintinib versus placebo: in FRESCO (fruquintinib: n = 278; placebo: n = 138), median OS was 9.3 with fruquintinib versus 6.6 months with placebo (hazard ratio [HR], 0.65; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.51-0.83; p < 0.001); in FRESCO-2 (fruquintinib: n = 461; placebo: n = 230), median OS was 7.4 with fruquintinib versus 4.8 months with placebo (HR, 0.66; 95% CI, 0.55-0.80; p < 0.001). The most common any-grade treatment-emergent adverse events with fruquintinib (incidence ≥ 20% in either study, excluding laboratory abnormalities) were hypertension, palmar-plantar erythrodysesthesia, proteinuria, dysphonia, diarrhea, asthenia, decreased appetite, hypothyroidism, and fatigue. This mini-review summarizes the mechanism of action, pharmacokinetics, key clinical trials, and clinical efficacy and safety data for fruquintinib.

papers.title_zh: Fruquintinib：作用機轉、臨床與轉譯科學
papers.abstract_zh: Fruquintinib是一種高度選擇性口服血管內皮生長因子受體（VEGFR-1、-2、-3）抑制劑，已於中國、美國及歐盟等地核准用於治療曾接受過治療之轉移性大腸直腸癌（mCRC）。Fruquintinib於mCRC的療效已在多項隨機、雙盲、第三期臨床試驗中一致證實，包括在中國招募病人的FRESCO試驗（NCT02314819）以及在北美、歐洲、亞洲、澳洲共14國招募病人的FRESCO-2試驗（NCT04322539）。兩項試驗皆以2:1比例隨機分配病人接受口服fruquintinib 5mg或安慰劑，每日一次，服用3週停藥1週，28天一週期，並合併最佳支持性照護，直至疾病惡化或無法耐受之毒性。FRESCO與FRESCO-2皆達到主要終點，顯示fruquintinib相較安慰劑在整體存活（OS）上有顯著改善：FRESCO試驗（fruquintinib組n=278；安慰劑組n=138）中位OS為9.3個月對6.6個月（風險比[HR] 0.65，95%信賴區間[CI] 0.51-0.83，p<0.001）；FRESCO-2試驗（fruquintinib組n=461；安慰劑組n=230）中位OS為7.4個月對4.8個月（HR 0.66，95% CI 0.55-0.80，p<0.001）。fruquintinib最常見的任何等級治療相關不良事件（兩試驗中任一發生率≥20%，不含實驗室異常）包括高血壓、手足皮膚反應、蛋白尿、聲音嘶啞、腹瀉、無力、食慾下降、甲狀腺功能低下及疲勞。本篇迷你綜述總結fruquintinib的作用機轉、藥物動力學、關鍵臨床試驗及臨床療效與安全性資料。

papers.title: A Straightforward and Reliable Mouse Model of Colorectal Cancer by Orthotopic Transplantation
papers.authors: Chen C, Fu Q, Gao C, Tanaka S, Imajo M
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is a major malignancy with significant global implications for human health. The development of a reliable and pathologically relevant orthotopic CRC model is essential for advancing our understanding of its molecular mechanisms and for developing more effective therapeutic interventions. However, the construction of such models is fraught with challenges primarily because of the technical complexities involved in the transplantation of CRC cells into the intestinal epithelium. In this chapter, we describe a recently developed method for generating an orthotopic CRC model within the mouse cecal epithelium. This model enables tumor development and progression within a natural tissue microenvironment and facilitates complex interactions between tumor cells and surrounding normal cells, thereby replicating the intratumor heterogeneity of CRC. All procedures in this method are visualized under stereomicroscopic observation, leading to the efficient engraftment of CRC cells and subsequent tumor development. The establishment of this reliable orthotopic CRC model, which mimics tumor development in a more natural microenvironment, offers new opportunities to explore the molecular mechanisms underlying CRC and to assess novel anticancer therapies in pathologically relevant contexts.
papers.title_zh: 透過原位移植建立一種簡單可靠的大腸直腸癌小鼠模型
papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌（CRC）是對全球人類健康具有重大影響的主要惡性腫瘤。建立一個可靠且具病理相關性的原位CRC模型，對於推進我們對其分子機制的理解以及開發更有效的治療介入至關重要。然而，此類模型的建構充滿挑戰，主要原因在於將CRC細胞移植至腸上皮所涉及的技術複雜性。在本章中，我們描述一種近期開發的方法，用於在小鼠盲腸上皮內建立原位CRC模型。此模型使腫瘤能在自然組織微環境中發展與進展，並促進腫瘤細胞與周圍正常細胞間的複雜交互作用，從而複製CRC的腫瘤內異質性。此方法的所有步驟均在立體顯微鏡觀察下進行，可有效率地達成CRC細胞的植入與後續腫瘤發展。此可靠的原位CRC模型的建立，能更自然地模擬腫瘤發展的微環境，為探索CRC的分子機制及在具病理相關性的情境下評估新型抗癌療法提供了新的機會。

papers.title: A Tissue Explant Model for Colon Cancer
papers.authors: Epiney J, Gussago S, Saint-Amour P, Khallouf J, Torres T, Vuagniaux A
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains a leading cause of cancer-related morbidity and mortality worldwide. Recent advancements in cancer research emphasize the importance of personalized medicine, necessitating robust preclinical models that closely mimic the tumor microenvironment. Colorectal cancer organoids have emerged as a pivotal tool in this domain, providing a platform that preserves the cellular heterogeneity and allows high-throughput drug testing. However, organoids do not recapitulate the complexity of the tumor ecosystem, its architecture, and stromal interactions characteristic of native tumors. Here, we describe a model to maintain CRC tissue explants in culture. These explants enable the assessment of therapeutic responses ex vivo. Furthermore, they may offer insights into tumor-immune interactions and facilitate the evaluation of novel immunotherapeutic agents. The continued refinement of CRC tissue explant models promises to enhance our understanding of tumor biology and improve the predictive accuracy of preclinical studies, ultimately contributing to more effective and personalized treatment strategies for colorectal cancer patients.

papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌（CRC）仍是全球癌症相關病歸與死亡的主要原因之一。癌症研究的最新進展強調個人化醫療的重要性，因此需要能緊密模擬腫瘤微環境的強健前臨床模型。大腸直腸癌類器官已成為此領域的關鍵工具，提供一個能保留細胞異質性並可進行高通量藥物測試的平台。然而，類器官無法重現原生腫瘤特有的腫瘤生態系複雜性、結構及間質交互作用。本文描述一種維持CRC組織explant培養的模型。這些explant能夠評估體外（ex vivo）治療反應。此外，它們可能提供腫瘤-免疫交互作用的洞見，並有助於評估新型免疫治療藥物。持續精進CRC組織explant模型有望增進我們對腫瘤生物學的理解、提升前臨床研究的預測準確性，最終有助於為大腸直腸癌患者提供更有效、更個人化的治療策略。

papers.title: Comprehensive Isolation Strategy for Intestinal Epithelial and Fibroblast Cells from Healthy and Tumor Human Tissues
papers.abstract: Organoids and fibroblasts derived from patient tissue serve as physiologically meaningful in vitro models to investigate tissue biology, diseases, and treatment responses. In this study, we present a robust protocol for the simultaneous isolation and long-term culture of patient-derived organoids (PDOs) and fibroblasts from both healthy and colorectal cancer samples. The workflow uses enzymatic dissociation followed by efficient separation into epithelial and stromal cell fractions. Organoids are embedded in Matrigel or Matrigel-Collagen I mixtures to support three-dimensional growth, whereas fibroblasts are maintained on conventional two-dimensional culture dishes. This dual-culture approach facilitates a broad range of downstream applications.

papers.abstract_zh: 由病人組織衍生之類器官與纖維母細胞，作為研究組織生物學、疾病與治療反應之具生理意義的體外模型。本研究提出一套穩健的方案，可同時分離並長期培養來自健康與大腸直腸癌組織之病人來源類器官（PDOs）與纖維母細胞。此工作流程使用酵素解離，隨後有效分離為上皮與間質細胞分群。類器官被包埋於Matrigel或Matrigel-Collagen I混合物中以支持三維生長，而纖維母細胞則維持於傳統二維培養皿中。此雙重培養方法有助於廣泛的下游應用。

papers.title: Stemness in Colon Cancer
papers.authors: Cohen-Almagor R, Sagadevan S, Ordóñez-Morán P
papers.abstract: Cell plasticity is a major driver of colorectal cancer (CRC), as tumors hijack intestinal stem cell regenerative programs to create a dynamic, bidirectional axis between complementary stem-like states. Cancer stem-like cells (CSCs) display hallmark stem cell properties, including self-renewal, multipotency, controlled differentiation, and quiescence, and are now recognized as key orchestrators of CRC biology. They can sustain tumor initiation and long-term growth, seed metastases, enable periods of dormancy, and promote resistance to chemotherapy. As a result, therapeutically dismantling CSC populations and their supportive niches offers a compelling strategy to improve treatment responses and ultimately patient survival.
papers.abstract_zh: 細胞可塑性是大腸直腸癌（CRC）的主要驅動因子，腫瘤劫持腸道幹細胞的再生程式，在互補的幹細胞樣狀態之間建立動態、雙向的軸線。癌症幹細胞樣細胞（CSCs）展現幹細胞的標誌性特徵，包括自我更新、多潛能性、受控的分化，以及靜止狀態，現已被認為是CRC生物學的關鍵調控者。它們能夠維持腫瘤的起始與長期生長、播種轉移、促成休眠期，並促進對化療的抗藥性。因此，透過治療手段瓦解CSC群體及其支持性微環境，提供了一個極具吸引力的策略，以改善治療反應並最終提升患者存活率。

papers.title: Intestinal Organoids Culture in Synthetic Hydrogels
papers.authors: Martinez-Espuga M, Mata A, Ordóñez-Morán P
papers.abstract: Derived from adult intestinal stem cells, organoids form intricate three-dimensional structures that closely mimic the cellular diversity and spatial organization of the human gut epithelium. Patient-derived organoids (PDOs) can recapitulate patient-specific tumor heterogeneity, making them highly valuable for colorectal cancer research and personalized medicine. However, their long-term in vitro culture still depends mainly on animal-derived materials (e.g., Matrigel) with undefined composition, batch variability, and limited tunability. To overcome these limitations, we introduced the use of synthetic peptide-based hydrogels, particularly peptide amphiphiles alone and in combination with extracellular matrix macromolecules, as a reproducible and tunable alternative. Here, we present a protocol for embedding PDOs in synthetic peptide-based hydrogels, and describe how to extract their RNA for transcriptomic analysis. This workflow enables the culture of intestinal PDOs in synthetic peptide-based hydrogels in a reproducible way, preserving key proliferation and differentiation lineage markers characteristic of PDOs.

papers.title_zh: 腸道類器官於合成水凝膠中之培養方法
papers.abstract_zh: 腸道類器官源自成人腸道幹細胞，形成複雜的三維結構，能高度模擬人類腸道上皮的細胞多樣性與空間組織。病人來源類器官（PDOs）可重現病人特異性的腫瘤異質性，因此在大腸直腸癌研究與個人化醫療上極具價值。然而，其長期體外培養仍主要依賴成分不明確、批次差異大、可調控性有限的動物來源材料（如 Matrigel）。為克服這些限制，我們引入合成胜肽基水凝膠的使用，特別是胜肽兩性分子（peptide amphiphiles）單獨使用或與細胞外基質大分子結合使用，作為一種可重現且可調控的替代方案。本文提出將 PDOs 包埋於合成胜肽基水凝膠之操作流程，並描述如何提取其 RNA 進行轉錄體分析。此工作流程可使腸道 PDOs 在合成胜肽基水凝膠中以可重現的方式培養，同時保留 PDOs 特徵性的增殖與分化系標記。

papers.title: Using In Silico Pseudobulk Differential Expression and Trajectory Analysis of Single Cell RNA Sequencing to Reveal Stem Cell State Transitions in Colonic Inflammation
papers.abstract: Colonic inflammation induces profound alterations in the intestinal mucosa that are evident at both macroscopic and microscopic levels, including disruption of epithelial barrier integrity, crypt fission, and immune cell infiltration. Recent advances in single-cell and spatial RNA sequencing have greatly expanded our understanding of the cellular diversity of the colonic mucosa, enabling pathological features to be directly linked to underlying cellular and molecular mechanisms. This chapter demonstrates the application of single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) analysis techniques to interrogate stem cell dynamics in the context of inflammatory bowel disease. Using publicly available datasets, the chapter provides a step-by-step workflow implemented in Python, covering data access, loading, integration of multiple datasets, and initial preprocessing. Cells are mapped to large single-cell atlas references to infer cell identities, followed by a pseudobulk analysis strategy to assess inflammation-associated changes in cell phenotypes. Finally, trajectory inference approaches are applied to explore potential mechanisms governing the specification and modulation of key cell types during inflammation. Accompanied by an online resource containing fully annotated scripts, this chapter offers guided instruction in contemporary scRNA-seq analysis workflows. It is intended as an accessible introduction for researchers seeking to develop practical skills in single-cell data analysis that can be readily applied to their own biological questions.

papers.title_zh: 利用單細胞RNA測序的矽基虛擬體差異表現與軌跡分析，揭示大腸發炎中幹細胞狀態轉換
papers.abstract_zh: 大腸發炎會誘發腸黏膜的深刻改變，這些改變在肉眼與顯微鏡層次皆可觀察到，包括上皮屏障完整性的破壞、隱窩分裂，以及免疫細胞浸潤。單細胞與空間RNA測序的最新進展，大幅擴展了我們對大腸黏膜細胞多樣性的理解，使病理特徵能直接與其underlying的細胞及分子機制連結。本章展示如何應用單細胞RNA測序（scRNA-seq）分析技術，探討發炎性腸道疾病情境下的幹細胞動態。使用公開可得的資料集，本章提供以Python實作的逐步工作流程，涵蓋資料存取、載入、多資料集整合，以及初步前處理。細胞被對應至大型單細胞圖譜參考資料以推論細胞身份，接著採用虛擬體（pseudobulk）分析策略以評估發炎相關的細胞表型變化。最後，應用軌跡推論方法，探討發炎過程中主導關鍵細胞類型specification與調節的潛在機制。本章附有線上資源，內含完整註解的程式腳本，提供當代scRNA-seq分析工作流程的引導式教學。本章旨在作為研究者發展單細胞資料分析實務技能的入門教材，使其能將此技能立即應用於自身的生物學問題。
